name: Harutonari (ハルトナリ。)
reasoning: I tried to break this by checking whether any wheat flour is actually used on premises and whether the record's own cited sources say what it claims. The GF claim does survive on two genuinely independent legs: Web-Komachi states 「グルテンフリーであることに加え、白砂糖も不使用」 for the Nagano rice-flour cakes, and a wheat-allergic Japanese blogger (gf-akane) visited and describes it as 「グルテンフリーのお菓子を提供する…カフェ」 with no adverse reaction; the shop's own Instagram bio independently claims 「グルテンフリーのお菓子と心地良い雰囲気を提供している大人の隠れ家カフェ」 and the account is active into Aug 2026. What I DID disprove is the record's sourcing: matsumoto.keizai.biz/headline/4296 — cited three times in the record's evidence block, including for the cross-contamination finding — contains NO mention of gluten-free, wheat, allergy or cross-contact at all; it only says 「米粉を使ったケーキやタルト」 and lists beer and sparkling wine. No source anywhere documents a wheat-free kitchen, so the record's gf_label "Fully gluten-free" and its inference that this is an "effectively wheat-free kitchen" are unsupported and should be softened; the menu also includes キッシュ (quiche) whose crust flour I could not verify.

Menu includes キッシュ (quiche) — crust flour unverified

Shop's own listing at nakamachi.org says only 「米の粉を使った甘み」 — it does not claim gluten-free
gf_label 'Fully gluten-free' over-claims; shop's own words are 'gluten-free sweets' (お菓子), not a GF kitchen
Second press source (mgpress.jp NEW!OPEN piece) now returns 404
plain_rice: No — sweets-and-coffee café, no rice dishes. Not a plain-gohan option.
identity_note: Identity confirmed: rice-flour sweets café inside なかまちのなか中村屋, 松本市中央3-4-12, opened 13 April 2025, Instagram @harutonari.2023 active into Aug 2026. Record's 'Matsumoto' neighborhood is right; note the record is filed under city 'nagano' though the shop is in Matsumoto.

name: Shinshu Juwari Soba Ten Karuizawa (信州十割そば てん 軽井沢店)
reasoning: I set out to verify the record's two load-bearing claims — 打ち粉不使用 and a グルテンフリーのつゆ — against the shop's own material plus an independent source, and the label did not survive. The GF tsuyu claim IS real and shop-stated (Instagram bio: 「天ぷら、蕎麦つゆ完全グルテンフリー🌿 信州蕎麦粉100%の十割蕎麦」; HotPepper: 「天ぷらも小麦粉を一切使用せず、そば粉と米粉をブレンドして作っています」), but the 打ち粉不使用 claim is NOT in the cited Karuizawa source at all — Web-Komachi p=235130 never mentions 打ち粉; that statement belongs to the SEPARATE Nagano-Station main branch article (p=100169: 「長野県・木島平産そば粉100％で作る十割そばは打ち粉不使用」), so the record has imported a main-branch fact and the 木島平産 sourcing onto the Karuizawa branch, which its own sources describe as 信州産. Decisively, the shop's OWN HotPepper listing carries the disclaimer 「尚、小麦を使用した製品も一部製造しております」 with the English line "While we offer gluten-free ingredients, cross-contact may occur in our kitchen" — the shop itself states wheat products are made on premises and that kitchen cross-contact can occur, which directly contradicts a 'Fully gluten-free' label and rules out the record's assumed soba-only wheat-free kitchen. Independent corroboration is also thin to nonexistent: Web-Komachi is a gourmet-media open-announcement piece, the pikyosama blog only relays 「完全グルテンフリーだそうです」 (hearsay, non-celiac blogger, asked staff nothing, observed nothing), and the shop is absent from the japan-glutenfree.com GF soba shop guide — so under the HARD RULE this is effectively one source and cannot hold high.
red_flags: SHOP'S OWN DISCLAIMER: 「尚、小麦を使用した製品も一部製造しております」 / "While we offer gluten-free ingredients, cross-contact may occur in our kitchen" — wheat IS on premises and the shop disclaims cross-contact
打ち粉不使用 is NOT stated for the Karuizawa branch by any source; the record mis-attributes the main-branch (長野駅前) fact to Web-Komachi p=235130, which never mentions 打ち粉
木島平産そば粉100% is the main branch's sourcing; Karuizawa sources say 信州産 (Kijimadaira + Yatsugatake foothills)
No dedicated/separate boiling pot documented anywhere — and with wheat products confirmed on premises, shared-pot risk is now live, not hypothetical
Only 'independent' write-up (Web-Komachi) is a PR-style opening announcement; the blog corroboration is explicit hearsay (「だそうです」) from a non-celiac writer who asked staff nothing
Not listed on the japan-glutenfree.com gluten-free soba shop guide — no celiac-grade corroboration exists
Record's gf_detail asserts the tsuyu differs from the main branch; Web-Komachi actually says 「本店と同じグルテンフリーのつゆ」 — the record's own narrative contradicts its source
plain_rice: Partly — lunch/limited rice-bowl sets exist (天丼・ローストビーフ丼), so plain white rice is likely orderable on request, but every donburi tare is a wheat-soy risk. Order plain unseasoned gohan only, no sauce.
identity_note: Business identity confirmed and still open: 十割そば shop, 軽井沢町軽井沢東6-1 芦沢ビル2F, ~2-3 min from Karuizawa Stn north exit, opened July 2025, second branch of the 長野駅前 shop; Instagram @ten_karuizawa active with a 1-year anniversary post in 2026. However the record's noodle-sourcing detail (木島平産) and the 打ち粉不使用 claim describe the MAIN branch, not this one.

name: Sorebana (そればな)
reasoning: I tried to disprove the 'all products gluten-free' claim by looking for wheat baking on premises, a shared kitchen, or a closure, and found none. The claim holds on three independent legs: Matsumoto Keizai Shimbun's 2020 opening piece interviews owner 三宅利佳 and reports 「グルテンフリーの焼き菓子」 plus 「三宅さん自身もグルテンフリーの生活をしており」; 号外NET 松本 visited independently in 2020 and again in 2022 and describes a gluten-free confectionery using organic/pesticide-free ingredients; and a wheat-allergic blogger (gf-akane) bought and ate the rice-flour bread sandwiches and dorayaki in June 2025 with no adverse reaction, recording the shop's own 【全商品グルテンフリー】 and 「小麦粉・白砂糖を使わず」 copy. The shop's own site independently states 「グルテンフリーのお菓子と喫茶」. I could not verify the record's 'mills her own rice' detail (the press only says she varies rice varieties by product), I found no 2026 confirmation that she is still trading, and the record's operational description is wrong in ways worth fixing.
red_flags: No source anywhere states a cross-contamination or shared-equipment policy — the wheat-free-kitchen conclusion rests entirely on the owner's product claim plus her own GF lifestyle
Record says 'takeout by advance phone reservation'; sources show an attached 喫茶/eat-in tea room with seating — the record understates the format

Record says 'opens only a few days a month'; 号外NET reports Thu/Fri/Sat weekly and the shop's own site says 12:00-17:00 不定休. Schedule appears to have narrowed by 2025 but is genuinely unstable — always confirm the day
'She mills her own rice' is not supported by any source I could reach; press only says she selects different rice varieties per product
No evidence of operation in 2026 (newest confirmation is June 2025); sorebana.stores.jp returned 403 so stock/activity could not be checked
Record's own gf_detail concedes only single-source corroboration — in fact there are three, but none address handling
plain_rice: No — rice-flour bakery and tea room, no cooked-rice dishes. Not a plain-gohan option.
identity_note: Identity confirmed: グルテンフリーのお菓子と喫茶 そればな, 松本市北深志1-11-7, tel 0263-88-6718, owner 三宅利佳, opened 24 May 2020 in the former 'Fiddle' bakery premises. Record's 北深志1丁目 address and solo-owner description are correct. Note the record is filed under city 'nagano' though the shop is in Matsumoto.

name: Miel Yakigashi Koubou (Miel焼菓子工房)
reasoning: The shop's OWN half of the dedicated bar is solid and I verified it live: netshop.lumierellc.net states 「当店のお菓子は全てグルテンフリーです」 and 「卵・乳・小麦粉不使用」, lumierellc.net/lumieres-sweets states the facility-level policy 「工房には卵・乳製品・小麦を持ち込まないため、安心してお召し上がりいただけます」 plus 「お店にて、アレルギーのヒアリングを行って商品を作ることも承ります」, and the Instagram bio 「卵小麦粉乳製品使わずみんな同じスイーツを。」 is active into July 2026 with an Aug 2026 closure notice — so the business is open and the claim is current. What I could NOT find, after hunting specifically for it, is the other half: ANY independent celiac-grade corroboration. There is no FindMeGlutenFree or HappyCow entry, no GF-Japan list entry, no allergy-parent blog write-up, and no in-person journalism; the only third party carrying the claim is a himeji-mitai gift roundup that reprints the shop's own 「三大アレルギー卵・乳製品・小麦を完全除去」 copy without a visit, while hitosara's listing contains no allergen information at all. Two of the record's five cited sources are now dead — sweetsguide.jp/shop/44055 returns 404 and the record's declared website www.miel-yakigashi.com does not resolve in DNS at all — so the evidence base is thinner than the record represents. Per the protocol, missing the independent celiac-grade leg means this cannot be dedicated; the strong, specific, verified no-wheat-on-premises policy still supports high, but Greg should be told the corroboration is essentially the shop talking about itself.

name: MIL bake (米粉専門店ミルベイク)
reasoning: I tried to find wheat anywhere in this operation and failed — the shop's own site states plainly 「工房では小麦粉を使用しません」 and 「国産米粉となるべく身体に負担のない材料で」, and the owner's motive is unusually credible: multiple independent reporters who interviewed her in person confirm she is a former pâtissier who developed occupational wheat allergy/小麦粉喘息 and can no longer handle wheat at all. Corroboration here is genuinely independent and first-hand: Kiss PRESS's reporter visited, sampled and interviewed the owner; local-prime.com ran a bylined editorial visit; tanosu.com ran a journalist visit with original photography noting the breads are 「小麦・乳・卵・ナッツ不使用」; and the 姫路の種 blogger photographed the storefront in person. What blocks `dedicated` is the protocol's other requirement — I found no celiac-grade corroboration at all (no FindMeGlutenFree or HappyCow entry, no GF-Japan list; the FMGF Himeji results surface other shops entirely), so the dedicated bar is not met and it drops one rung. Note also that the record's own-site evidence describes a home workshop, while the shop has since moved to a retail storefront in 田寺 (28 Sept 2025) and dropped its reservation-only model.
